column1: # macboot — GUI applications. LISTED, NEVER INSTALLED (spec: "GUI apps — listed,
# never installed"). 99-apps.sh reads this file, reports what is missing and
# prints the command; the decision stays with you. Each row below is a licence, a
# login or a several-hundred-megabyte download, and `brew install --cask` against
# an app that was dragged in by hand aborts with "It seems there is already an App
# at ...", which is a worse first five minutes than a table.
# Format: four TAB-separated columns, no quoting, no `|`:
#   name<TAB>tier<TAB>install_hint<TAB>note
#   name          the app's display name, as a human would say it
#   tier          must = the toolchain the rest of this repo assumes
#                 nice = my taste; you decide
#   install_hint  the exact `brew install --cask <token>` line, or empty when no
#                 cask exists (then the note has to say how)
#   note          why it is here, or the one thing that bites
# Tabs are the only separator because notes contain spaces and commas. Detection
# lives in 99-apps.sh: it matches install_hint's token against `brew list --cask`
# and looks for a bundle in /Applications, with a three-entry exception table for
# the apps whose bundle is not "<name>.app" (iTerm2 ships iTerm.app, Docker
# Desktop ships Docker.app, Claude Code ships no bundle at all).
Visual Studio Code
column4: Editor everything else here assumes. Settings Sync is a GitHub login; macboot does not touch it.

column1: iTerm2
column4: Bundle is /Applications/iTerm.app, not iTerm2.app — the reason 99-apps.sh has an exception table.

column1: Claude Code
column4: A CLI, not an .app: nothing lands in /Applications, so detection falls back to PATH. It self-updates, so `brew info` will lag. 70-claude.sh needs it on PATH to install the one plugin.

column1: Google Chrome
column4: For checking what Safari renders differently, and for the DevTools protocol.

column1: Docker Desktop
column4: `brew install docker` now installs the CLI-only formula, which is NOT this. Watch the build cache: it reached 76 GB logical on my machine before I noticed.

column1: Raycast
column4: The ⌘-Space swap away from Spotlight is two clicks by hand — see notes/MANUAL-STEPS.md, it is deliberately not scripted.

column1: Obsidian
column4: Plain Markdown in a folder you choose. macboot creates no vault and syncs nothing.
